import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,ctypes as C,hashlib,struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from wire import NAMES,emissions,packet,payload

def build():
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='epic-')
    p=subprocess.run(['make','-s','-C','/workspace/project','BUILD='+d,'-j2'],capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()
    return C.CDLL(os.path.join(d,'libepic.so'))

def run(case,lib,verbose=False):
    tape=hashlib.sha256();accepted=0;wire_bytes=0;budget=-1;trace=[];snaps=[]
    limit=case.get('trace',0)
    CALLBACK=C.CFUNCTYPE(C.c_int,C.c_void_p,C.c_int,C.POINTER(C.c_uint8),C.c_size_t)
    def emit(user,rank,pointer,length):
        nonlocal accepted,wire_bytes,budget
        if budget==0:return 0
        if budget>0:budget-=1
        frame=C.string_at(pointer,length)
        tape.update(bytes((rank,))+struct.pack('<I',length)+frame)
        accepted+=1;wire_bytes+=length
        if len(trace)<limit:trace.append({'rank':rank,'hex':frame.hex()})
        return 1
    cb=CALLBACK(emit)
    lib.epic_open.argtypes=[C.c_int]*3+[C.c_uint32]*4+[CALLBACK,C.c_void_p];lib.epic_open.restype=C.c_void_p
    lib.epic_ingress.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_int,C.c_char_p,C.c_size_t]
    lib.epic_flush.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];lib.epic_retry.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_int]
    lib.epic_close.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];lib.epic_state.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.POINTER(C.c_uint64)]
    lib.epic_digest.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];lib.epic_digest.restype=C.c_uint64
    ctx=lib.epic_open(NAMES.index(case['primitive']),case['mode'],case['root'],case['segments'],case['words'],case['capacity'],case['start'],cb,None)
    assert ctx
    def snap():
        st=(C.c_uint64*32)();lib.epic_state(ctx,st)
        return {'state':list(st),'buffer':'%016x'%lib.epic_digest(ctx),'wire_sha256':tape.hexdigest(),'packets':accepted,'bytes':wire_bytes}
    try:
        for name,arg,frame in emissions(case):
            if name=='wire':lib.epic_ingress(ctx,arg,frame,len(frame))
            elif name=='flush':lib.epic_flush(ctx)
            elif name=='retry':lib.epic_retry(ctx,arg)
            elif name=='budget':budget=arg
            elif name=='snap':snaps.append({'tag':arg,**snap()})
        return {**snap(),'snapshots':snaps,'trace':trace}
    finally:lib.epic_close(ctx)

LABELS=['b','occ','R0','R1','R2','R3','S0','S1','S2','S3','A0','A1','A2','A3','U0','U1','U2','U3',
        'rxdata','rxack','txdata','txack','acc','dup','blocked','stale','badwire','badend','ignack','failed','ovw','res']
def show(res):
    st=res['state']
    print('   ', ' '.join('%s=%d'%(LABELS[i],st[i]) for i in range(32) if st[i]))
    print('    buf=%s pkts=%d bytes=%d'%(res['buffer'],res['packets'],res['bytes']))
PYEOF
